afrexai-spend-intelligence 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Guides users through a multi-step process to analyze, categorize, and optimize company spending.

- Benchmarks spending categories against 2026 industry standards for SaaS, Professional Services, and Manufacturing.
- Generates prioritized, actionable cost-reduction plans with savings projections, assigned owners, and timelines.
